title: Recovery of phytochemical compounds from the aqueous extract remaining after enzymatic extraction of sesame oil using cellulase and pepsin
content:
Sustainable Food Technol., 2026, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5FB00522A, Paper

Queous extracts from enzymatic sesame oil extraction were rich in phenolics, antioxidants, vitamins, and proteins, showing strong potential as sustainable bioactive sources.
